verdict.rationale: IP India's own pages link a public application-status search from 'Track Status', and the evidence notes no account is named on that entry. That is a keyless or application-number entry path for status lookup, and public search pages also exist. However, nothing shows the core e-filing flow can be started without registering, and keyless access is inferred from no login being mentioned rather than stated outright. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the e-filing flow can begin without an account, an explicit statement that status lookup needs only a file or application number, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path

citations.quote: "Track Status" resolves to the public application-status search on iprsearch.ipindia.gov.in, no account named on the entry.
